tasks.subject: Task 1: Store fill direction (dir)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persist Hyperliquid's human-readable `dir` on every fill, with an additive migration for existing databases.

**Files:**
- Modify: db.js (SCHEMA, migration block, insertFill, ingestTxn)
- Modify: hyperliquid.js:80-94 (normalizeFills)
- Test: test/db.test.js, test/hyperliquid.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Fresh databases create `fills` with a `dir TEXT` column
- [ ] Pre-existing databases gain the column without losing rows
- [ ] normalizeFills carries `dir` and yields null when absent
- [ ] Callers that omit `dir` still insert successfully (ingestTxn defaults it)

**Verify:** npm test

**Steps:** write failing tests -> add dir to SCHEMA -> PRAGMA table_info migration -> update insertFill + ingestTxn default -> normalizeFills carries dir -> green -> commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.js", "hyperliquid.js", "test/db.test.js", "test/hyperliquid.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fresh DB has fills.dir", "migration preserves existing rows", "normalizeFills carries dir, null when absent", "ingestFills defaults dir for callers that omit it"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Paginated fill queries
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add listFills and countFills to the db handle, with stable ordering and a closes-only filter.

**Files:**
- Modify: db.js (prepared statements + returned methods)
- Test: test/db.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] listFills orders by `ts DESC, tid DESC` so pagination is stable when timestamps collide
- [ ] limit/offset page with no duplicated or skipped rows
- [ ] closesOnly returns only rows with closed_pnl != 0
- [ ] countFills agrees with unpaginated listFills under the same filter

**Verify:** npm test

**Steps:** write failing test -> add 4 prepared statements (all/closes x list/count) -> expose listFills/countFills -> green -> commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.js", "test/db.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["newest-first total ordering by ts DESC, tid DESC", "pagination covers each row once", "closesOnly filters to closed_pnl != 0", "countFills agrees with listFills"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: GET /api/fills/:address
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose the paginated fills query over HTTP with address validation and server-side clamping.

**Files:**
- Modify: server.js (route after /api/history/:address)
- Test: test/server.test.js (route tests + fakeDb additions + withServer fills seed)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Invalid addresses return 400
- [ ] limit defaults 50, clamps 1-200; offset defaults 0, clamps >= 0
- [ ] closesOnly true only for the exact string "true"
- [ ] Response is { address, fills, total, limit, offset }

**Verify:** npm test

**Steps:** extend fakeDb + withServer(fills seed as trailing default arg) -> write failing route tests -> add route -> green -> commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["server.js", "test/server.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["400 on invalid address", "limit/offset clamped server-side", "closesOnly exact-string match", "response shape { address, fills, total, limit, offset }"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Trade History panel UI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Render stored fills in a paginated, filterable panel below Open Positions.

**Files:**
- Modify: public/index.html:36 (id on chart toggle), public/index.html:56 (new section)
- Modify: public/styles.css (pager, direction column alignment)
- Modify: public/app.js:175-179 (scope chart toggle selector) + state/fetch/render/wiring

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Chart series toggle still works, unaffected by the new filter buttons (the `.toggle button` selector must be scoped to #chartToggle first)
- [ ] Columns: Time, Coin, Direction, Size, Price, Fee, Realized PnL
- [ ] Realized PnL uses pos/neg coloring, shows em dash for fills that closed nothing
- [ ] Direction falls back to Buy/Sell from `side` for pre-migration rows
- [ ] Closes-only toggle filters and resets to offset 0
- [ ] Prev/next paginate; range reads X-Y of N; buttons disable at the ends
- [ ] Selecting a different wallet reloads from offset 0

**Verify:** npm start + browser check; npm test still passes

**Steps:** scope chart toggle -> markup -> styles -> fills state -> render/load fns -> hook into refresh + selectAddress -> wire controls -> browser verify -> commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["public/index.html", "public/styles.css", "public/app.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["chart toggle unaffected by new filter buttons", "seven columns render", "em dash for zero closed_pnl", "dir falls back to side", "closes-only resets offset", "pager range and disabled states correct", "wallet switch resets to page 1"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Live-append new fills
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Push newly observed fills into the panel over the existing WebSocket without a refetch.

**Files:**
- Modify: ws-server.js:24-29 (rows ride along on the existing realized broadcast)
- Modify: public/app.js (appendLiveFills + realized branch)
- Test: test/hl-stream.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] One upstream fills event produces one downstream message
- [ ] Rows already rendered are not duplicated (dedupe by tid)
- [ ] Rows append only at offset 0 and only when matching the active filter
- [ ] total increments by the count matching the ACTIVE FILTER, not every fresh fill
- [ ] Appending respects limit so the page does not grow unbounded

**Verify:** npm test; manually observe a live fill appear at the top

**Steps:** pin broadcast contract test -> add fills to broadcast -> appendLiveFills -> hook realized branch -> green -> commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ws-server.js", "public/app.js", "test/hl-stream.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["single downstream message per upstream event", "tid dedupe", "append only at offset 0 and matching filter", "total increments by filter-matching count only", "page re-sliced to limit"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Purge on delete + stream.untrack
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make wallet deletion remove snapshots and fills, stop the upstream subscription, and validate the address.

**Files:**
- Modify: db.js (deleteWallet transaction, replacing removeWallet)
- Modify: hl-stream.js:73-75 (untrack)
- Modify: server.js (destructure stream from overrides; DELETE route; reorder startup so the app gets the stream)
- Test: test/db.test.js, test/hl-stream.test.js, test/server.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] deleteWallet removes from wallets, snapshots, fills in one transaction
- [ ] Other wallets' data untouched
- [ ] untrack sends unsubscribe and drops the address from the reconnect resubscribe set
- [ ] DELETE rejects invalid addresses with 400
- [ ] DELETE calls untrack when a stream is supplied, no-ops safely without one

**Verify:** npm test

**Note:** independent of tasks 1-5 except that the deleteWallet purge test calls countFills (task 2). Renames db.removeWallet -> db.deleteWallet; update the existing 'wallet upsert/list/remove' test and fakeDb.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.js", "hl-stream.js", "server.js", "test/db.test.js", "test/hl-stream.test.js", "test/server.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["three-table transactional purge", "other wallets untouched", "untrack unsubscribes and clears reconnect set", "DELETE validates address", "DELETE untracks when stream present, no-ops otherwise"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Delete UI + docs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make deletion discoverable and confirmed, and reset the dashboard when the last wallet is removed.

**Files:**
- Modify: public/index.html:16 (labeled delete control)
- Modify: public/app.js:194-198 (confirm + post-delete reset)
- Modify: README.md

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Delete control has visible text, not a tooltip-only glyph
- [ ] Confirmation names the wallet and states its history will be erased
- [ ] Cancelling deletes nothing
- [ ] After deleting the last wallet, cards/positions/chart/agents/badge/Trade History reset and status reads "Enter a wallet"
- [ ] Deleting a non-selected wallet leaves the current view intact
- [ ] README documents the panel and that deletion purges data (including the DEFAULT_WALLET caveat)

**Verify:** npm start + browser check; npm test still passes

**Note:** blockedBy task 4 because resetDashboard calls renderFills, and task 6 because the confirm text promises a purge the backend must actually perform.
